ranks: The need-keys recheck list R5 (Phase 1 step 2)

blocked.name: Fevered Visions
blocked.why: 'If the player is your opponent and has four or more cards in hand': hand-size reads only you or each player, not the active player at their end step.

blocked.name: Gandalf, Wandering Wizard
blocked.why: 'Gandalf's owner … draws three cards': draw can't name the source's owner (who isn't always its controller).

blocked.name: Heartwood Storyteller
blocked.why: 'Each of that player's opponents may draw': no scope for the caster's opponents.

blocked.name: Nature's Will
blocked.why: 'Tap all lands that player controls' for the damaged player: tap-all narrows only to a target slot's player.

blocked.name: Oblation
blocked.why: 'The owner of target nonland permanent … draws two cards': draw has no owner-of-target player.

blocked.name: Papalymo Totolymo
blocked.why: 'Each opponent who lost life this turn sacrifices …': no such scope (turn-stat conditions read you or any opponent only).

blocked.name: Silumgar, the Drifting Death
blocked.why: 'Creatures defending player controls get -1/-1': modify-pt-all can't scope to the defending player.

blocked.name: Unidentified Hovership
blocked.why: 'The exiled card's owner manifests dread': manifest-dread's who is you or a target's controller.

blocked.name: Wheel and Deal
blocked.why: 'Any number of target opponents each discard their hands, then draw seven': discard-hand takes only a scope.

blocked.name: Zenith Chronicler
blocked.why: 'Each other player' than the caster draws: no scope relative to the caster.

blocked.name: Chainer, Dementia Master
blocked.why: The reanimated creature 'is black and is a Nightmare': put-onto-battlefield adds subtypes but no colour.

blocked.name: Ghost Vacuum
blocked.why: Each creature card exiled with it returns with a flying counter as a 1/1 Spirit in addition: the riders aren't expressible.

blocked.name: Ghoulish Impetus
blocked.why: The delayed 'return this card to the battlefield' must return only the card still in the graveyard it went to; no delayed shape is gated that way in the pool.

blocked.name: Grave Betrayal
blocked.why: Returns as 'a black Zombie in addition to its other colors': no added colour.

blocked.name: Nissa of Shadowed Boughs
blocked.why: −5 puts a creature card from your hand or graveyard: no choice across both zones.

blocked.name: Valkyrie's Call
blocked.why: Returns with 'flying and is an Angel': put-onto-battlefield grants no keywords as it enters.

blocked.name: Getaway Barrel
blocked.why: 'A random creature card from among' the thirteen revealed.

blocked.name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
blocked.why: Each owner of a spell cast this way loses life equal to its mana value.

blocked.name: Last One Standing
blocked.why: 'Choose a creature at random, then destroy the rest': no untargeted random permanent.

blocked.name: Omenpath Journey
blocked.why: 'Choose a card at random exiled with this enchantment': choose-random-card doesn't read linked exile.

blocked.name: Orcish Librarian
blocked.why: Exile four of the top eight at random.

blocked.name: Rag Man
blocked.why: 'Discards a creature card at random': discard's random takes no filter.

blocked.name: Rona, Herald of Invasion
blocked.why: The back face's 'exiles a card from their hand at random', then plays it: choose-random-card reads no hand.

blocked.name: Scrambleverse
blocked.why: A random player chosen for each nonland permanent, each gaining control of theirs.

blocked.name: Summon: Magus Sisters
blocked.why: Each chapter chooses a mode at random as it goes on the stack, among modes with legal targets.

blocked.name: Urza's Bauble
blocked.why: 'Look at a card at random in target player's hand'.

blocked.name: Foray of Orcs
blocked.why: X is the amassed Army's power, for a reflexive damage target.

blocked.name: Swashbuckler Extraordinaire
blocked.why: Sacrifice one or more Treasures, then up to that many targets gain double strike.

blocked.name: Yes Man, Personal Securitron
blocked.why: 'When they do' after the control change: no record that it happened.

blocked.name: Bill Ferny, Bree Swindler
blocked.why: Mode 2's 'if they do' after giving the Horse away (remove-from-combat is built).

blocked.name: Descendants' Fury
blocked.why: Sacrifice one of the creatures that dealt the damage, then reveal until a creature card sharing a creature type with it.

blocked.name: Goblin Charbelcher
blocked.why: Damage equal to the nonland cards revealed this way, doubled if the land found is a Mountain; the rest to the bottom in any order.

blocked.name: Mind Grind
blocked.why: Each opponent reveals until X land cards and mills them all.

blocked.name: Old Stickfingers
blocked.why: Reveal until X creature cards and put them into the graveyard: reveal-until-count puts the found cards only onto the battlefield.

blocked.name: Part in Friendship
blocked.why: The found creature card onto the battlefield or, by its mana value, into your hand.

blocked.name: Read the Runes
blocked.why: For each card drawn, discard a card unless you sacrifice a permanent.

blocked.name: Sword of the Ages
blocked.why: Sacrifice this and any number of creatures; X is their total power.

blocked.name: Pyre of Heroes
blocked.why: A creature card sharing a creature type with the sacrificed creature: sharesCreatureTypeWith reads only the trigger object or source.

blocked.name: Puca's Eye
blocked.why: 'Choose a color. This artifact becomes the chosen color' as it resolves.

blocked.name: Elvish Soultiller
blocked.why: Shuffle only the creature cards of the chosen type from your graveyard into your library.

blocked.name: Yosei, the Morning Star
blocked.why: The skip is built (skip-untap-step); 'tap up to five target permanents that player controls' needs targets tied to the target player slot.

blocked.name: Pretender's Claim
blocked.why: Tap all lands the defending player controls.

blocked.name: Tectonic Instability
blocked.why: Tap all lands the entering land's controller controls.

blocked.name: Sorin, Lord of Innistrad
blocked.why: −6's 'creatures and/or other planeswalkers': Sorin targetable while he's a creature (the ruling).

blocked.name: Abstruse Archaic
blocked.why: An ability target 'from a colorless source'.

blocked.name: Blatant Thievery
blocked.why: One target per opponent, among the permanents that opponent controls.

blocked.name: Ertai Resurrected
blocked.why: 'Its controller draws a card' for the countered spell or ability, or the destroyed creature: draw takes only a player slot.

blocked.name: Joshua, Phoenix's Dominant
blocked.why: Chapter III: any number of target creature cards with total mana value 6 or less.

blocked.name: Loaming Shaman
blocked.why: Any number of target cards from the target player's graveyard, shuffled in.

blocked.name: Louisoix's Sacrifice
blocked.why: 'Activated ability, triggered ability, or noncreature spell' in one slot.

blocked.name: Rampaging Yao Guai
blocked.why: Any number of artifacts and/or enchantments with total mana value X or less.

blocked.name: Tale's End
blocked.why: 'Activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell' in one slot.

blocked.name: The Peregrine Dynamo
blocked.why: 'From another legendary source that's not a commander'.

blocked.name: Unsubstantiate
blocked.why: 'Target spell or creature': spell-or-permanent's filter applies to both.

blocked.name: Verdant Command
blocked.why: 'Counter target loyalty ability of a planeswalker'.

blocked.name: Wrathful Raptors
blocked.why: 'Any target that isn't a Dinosaur'.

blocked.name: Atarka's Command
blocked.why: 'Your opponents can't gain life this turn' (the other three modes are expressible).

blocked.name: Domri, Anarch of Bolas
blocked.why: 'Creature spells you cast this turn can't be countered'.

blocked.name: Roiling Vortex
blocked.why: '{R}: Your opponents can't gain life this turn'.

blocked.name: Screaming Nemesis
blocked.why: A player dealt damage this way can't gain life for the rest of the game.

blocked.name: Bringer of the Last Gift
blocked.why: Each player returns their own graveyard's creature cards not put there this way.

blocked.name: Cache Grab
blocked.why: 'Returned a Squirrel card to your hand this way' after the mill-and-choose.

blocked.name: Coalition Relic
blocked.why: Mana for each charge counter removed this way.

blocked.name: Discerning Taste
blocked.why: Life equal to the greatest power among creature cards put into the graveyard this way.

blocked.name: Flood of Tears
blocked.why: Four or more nontoken permanents you controlled returned this way, a commander sent to the command zone counted (ruling).

blocked.name: Ingenious Prodigy
blocked.why: 'You may remove a +1/+1 counter. If you do, draw': nothing records the counter actually removed.

blocked.name: Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger
blocked.why: Each opponent who didn't discard a nonland card this way loses 3 life.

blocked.name: Marauding Raptor
blocked.why: 'If a Dinosaur is dealt damage this way' about the entering creature (not a target slot).

blocked.name: Mob Rule
blocked.why: Untap and give haste to exactly the creatures taken (the ruling: not re-filtered by power).

blocked.name: Rise and Shine
blocked.why: Overloaded, counters go on each artifact that became a creature this way.

blocked.name: Spectacular Showdown
blocked.why: Goad each creature that had a double strike counter put on it this way.

blocked.name: Szat's Will
blocked.why: X is the greatest power among creature cards exiled this way.

blocked.name: Cleaver Skaab
blocked.why: Two token copies of the creature sacrificed as the cost.

blocked.name: Clone Legion
blocked.why: A copy of each creature target player controls.

blocked.name: Doppelgang
blocked.why: X copies of each of X targets: create-token-copy's count is fixed.

blocked.name: Endless Evil
blocked.why: A 1/1 token copy of the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Fractured Identity
blocked.why: Each player other than its controller creates a copy: create-token-copy's who is you or the copied permanent's controller.

blocked.name: Life of the Party
blocked.why: Each opponent creates a copy, goaded for the rest of the game.

blocked.name: Mirrorhall Mimic
blocked.why: Ghastly Mimicry's token copy of the enchanted creature.

blocked.name: Summon: Good King Mog XII
blocked.why: Chapters II–III: a turn-long cast trigger copying a chosen non-Saga token.

blocked.name: Twilight Diviner
blocked.why: A copy of one of the creatures that entered together.

blocked.name: Ultron, Artificial Malevolence
blocked.why: A noncreature token copy becomes a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.

blocked.name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
blocked.why: A copy of the artifact or creature the cast spell targets.

blocked.name: Cleansing
blocked.why: For each land, destroy it unless any player pays 1 life.

blocked.name: Scarwood Bandits
blocked.why: 'Unless an opponent pays {2}': any-player asks you too.
